info.title: subramanya.ai Content API
info.summary: Read-only content API for Subramanya N's personal site
info.description:
Machine-readable, read-only API surface of subramanya.ai, the personal site of Subramanya N (AI agents, agent security, SaaS strategy). All endpoints are static files served by GitHub Pages over anonymous HTTPS GET - no authentication, no API key, no rate-limit registration required. There are no write operations. Every HTML page also has a parallel markdown twin at `<page-url>index.md` (see the getPageMarkdown operation).

## Versioning and deprecation

Structured JSON resources live under the URL-path-versioned prefix `/api/v1/`. The v1 surface is additive-only: fields may be added, but existing fields, paths, and semantics will not change or disappear within v1. Any breaking change would ship as a new `/api/v2/` prefix while `/api/v1/` keeps working for at least 6 months; a deprecation is announced in this spec, in /llms.txt, and in the site changelog before a retired path starts returning 404/410. Root-level discovery files (/llms.txt, /search.json, /sitemap.xml, /feed.xml, /openapi.json) follow their respective public standards and are likewise stable.

## Rate limits and errors

There are no per-client rate limits and no RateLimit response headers - content is served by the Fastly CDN; please cache respectfully (responses carry Cache-Control and ETag headers). Because the host is a static CDN, error responses for unknown paths return HTTP 404 with an HTML body that links back to /llms.txt, /sitemap.xml, and /search.json for recovery; JSON error bodies and Accept-header content negotiation are not available.

tags.name: discovery
tags.description: Endpoints that help agents discover what exists on the site

get.description: Returns this OpenAPI 3.1 document describing the site's read-only content API.

get.summary: List all blog posts (v1, typed JSON)
get.description: Returns every blog post as a typed JSON object: title, canonical HTML URL, markdown twin URL, ISO date, excerpt, and tags. Newest first. Part of the additive-only /api/v1/ versioned surface; see the versioning policy in the spec description.

200.description: The full list of blog posts.

get.summary: List all book notes (v1, typed JSON)
get.description: Returns every book note as a typed JSON object: title, canonical HTML URL, markdown twin URL, ISO date, excerpt, and tags. Part of the additive-only /api/v1/ versioned surface; see the versioning policy in the spec description.

200.description: The full list of book notes.

get.summary: Full-text search index of posts, books, and loops
get.description: Returns the complete search index as a JSON array (~0.5 MB). Each item is a blog post, book note, or automation-loop prompt with title, URL, plain-text content, tags, view count, and reading time. Agents should fetch this once and filter client-side; there is no server-side query parameter. For a lighter, typed list without full content, use listPosts or listBooks.
Returns the llmstxt.org-format summary of the site: what it is, when an agent should use it, and links to every page's markdown twin.

get.summary: Full site content for LLM ingestion
get.description: Returns the full text of every blog post in one markdown document, including FAQ question/answer pairs where present. Large response; prefer /search.json plus per-page markdown twins for targeted reads.
Returns the most recent blog posts as an RSS 2.0 feed.
Returns the canonical URL list for the site in Sitemaps 0.9 XML format. Use this to enumerate every crawlable page.
Returns an RFC 9727 / RFC 9264 linkset cataloguing every machine-readable endpoint on the site, including this OpenAPI document.

get.summary: Markdown twin of any HTML page
get.description: Every HTML page on the site has a parallel markdown representation at `<page-url>index.md`, served as `text/markdown; charset=utf-8`. For example, the markdown twin of https://subramanya.ai/work/ is https://subramanya.ai/work/index.md. The site homepage's twin is /index.md. Page URLs are enumerated in /sitemap.xml and /llms.txt; each HTML page also advertises its twin via `<link rel="alternate" type="text/markdown">`.

parameters.name: pagePath
parameters.description: The page's URL path without leading or trailing slash, e.g. `work`, `blog`, or `2026/08/17/break-in-break-out-ai-agent-security`.

NotFound.description: The path does not exist. The static host (GitHub Pages) returns a real HTTP 404 status with an HTML body; the body links to /llms.txt, /sitemap.xml, /search.json, and /.well-known/api-catalog so agents can recover. JSON error bodies are not available on this static host.

schema.description: HTML 404 page with recovery links for agents

ContentItem.description: A blog post or book note in the versioned v1 API.

title.description: Title of the post or book note.

url.description: Canonical absolute URL of the HTML page.

markdown_url.description: Absolute URL of the page's markdown twin (text/markdown).

PostList.description: Envelope for the blog post list.

generated_from.description: URL of the OpenAPI spec describing this endpoint.

count.description: Number of posts in the list.

BookList.description: Envelope for the book note list.

generated_from.description: URL of the OpenAPI spec describing this endpoint.

count.description: Number of book notes in the list.

SearchItem.description: One entry in the site search index: a blog post, a book note, or an automation-loop prompt.

kind.description: Whether this entry is a blog post, a book note, or an automation loop from /awesome-loops/.

url.description: Site-relative URL of the HTML page. Append `index.md` for the markdown twin.

date_display.description: Human-readable publication date, e.g. 'August 17, 2026'. Null for undated entries such as loops.

date_iso.description: Publication date in YYYY-MM-DD format, or null for undated entries.

views.description: Page views from site analytics; null when analytics are unavailable for the entry.

reading_minutes.description: Estimated reading time in minutes at 200 wpm; null for entries without it.

tags.description: Topic tags. Tag archive pages live at /tags/.

SearchTag.description: A topic tag on a search item.

name.description: Display name of the tag, e.g. 'AI Agents'.

slug.description: URL slug of the tag; the archive page is /tags/#<slug>.
